title: Nkarta Reports Initial NKX019 Clinical Responses in Myositis and Systemic Sclerosis Trials
summary: Nkarta (NASDAQ:NKTX) has reported preliminary clinical data from its Ntrust trial programme evaluating NKX019, an investigational allogeneic CAR natural killer (NK) cell therapy, in patients with autoimmune diseases. The findings, presented at the American College of Rheumatology Convergence 2026 meeting in Orlando, included early treatment responses in patients with myositis and systemic sclerosis.
